tasks.title: Nmap WinRM Scan
tasks.description: Verify WinRM ports (5985 HTTP / 5986 HTTPS) and check supported authentication methods.

tasks.title: Password Spraying (CME / NetExec)
tasks.description: Spray known user lists and custom wordlists against the WinRM service.

tasks.title: Evil-WinRM (Password)
tasks.description: Gain an interactive PowerShell session using known plaintext credentials.

tasks.title: Evil-WinRM (Pass-The-Hash)
tasks.description: Gain an interactive PowerShell session using an NTLM hash. Bypasses the need to crack the hash.

tasks.title: Native PowerShell (Enter-PSSession)
tasks.description: Connect natively from a Windows attack box or an already compromised Windows host.

tasks.title: Evil-WinRM File Transfers
tasks.description: Once inside an Evil-WinRM session, use the built-in commands to easily upload and download files.

tasks.title: Evil-WinRM Load Scripts in Memory
tasks.description: Bypass disk-based AV by loading PowerShell scripts (like PowerView or WinPEAS) directly into memory.
